steps: Rinse quinoa; combine with 500 ml water in a saucepan and bring to a boil, then simmer covered for 15 minutes until absorbed.
Dice onion and bell pepper; slice zucchini into half-moons; mince garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and bell pepper; cook for 4 minutes, stirring, until softened.
Add garlic, cumin, and paprika; stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add sliced zucchini and cook for 3 minutes, stirring, until slightly tender.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and drained cooked black beans; stir to combine.
Simmer uncovered over medium-low heat for 8 to 10 minutes until sauce thickens and zucchini is fully soft.
Spoon quinoa into bowls and top with the black bean and zucchini skillet mixture.
Serve warm; refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.
